title: A dropped test id names the removed code it tested, and a dropped test whose module is still present is flagged
goal: Retro SP-ytfb4dc5: deleting test_autopilot_two_runners.py dropped the kg_lock tests that land and sync rely on, and perfcheck ids --allow-removed accepted it (BG-m4pixy3p). perfcheck ids (or a check beside it) warns of a test id in test_ids_dropped.txt whose recorded reason names no removed file or symbol, and of a dropped test file whose imports are all still present modules, so a removal that drops tests of live code is seen before it lands. Planted tests for both.
